title: Fastly Expands Partnership with Jio Platforms to Power the Next Generation of India’s Digital Economy
summary: JioCDN Powered by Fastly Now Enables Secure, High-Performance Digital Experiences for Businesses Across India
body_markdown:
*JioCDN Powered by Fastly Now Enables Secure, High-Performance Digital Experiences for Businesses Across India*


**San Francisco – Oct 13, 2026 –** Fastly (NASDAQ: FSLY), a leader in global edge cloud platforms, today announced the expansion of its partnership with Jio Platforms Limited (JPL) to boost JioCDN, a leading Content Delivery Network in India built on Jio’s infrastructure, now offering best-in-class services to businesses across India.


JioCDN, powered by Fastly, is designed from the ground up for the scale, diversity, and complexity of the Indian digital market, from metro cities to towns. With one of the largest CDN capacities in India, the platform has already proven its carrier-grade capabilities, powering Reliance group’s digital ecosystem, including JioHotstar, AJIO, and JioTV, among others. The enhanced JioCDN platform enables secure and resilient digital experiences for Indian businesses.


JioCDN is built on Jio’s deep network infrastructure, spanning 5G and fixed broadband across India and powered by Fastly’s programmable edge cloud. This combination enables businesses to innovate quickly, as well as to secure and accelerate workloads on a platform optimized for global scale, backed by Fastly’s intelligent network architecture.


“India is one of the world’s most exciting and demanding digital markets, and JPL is an ideal partner to bring Fastly’s edge platform to this rapidly expanding market,” said Scott Lovett, President, Go to Market at Fastly. “JioCDN has already delivered tremendous value to customers, including some of the largest live-streamed events in history. This is a testament to the secure, high-performance, and innovative platform we have built together at scale.”


“India’s digital economy is growing at an unprecedented pace, and our partnership with Fastly enables us to provide the platform businesses need to offer seamless digital experiences to end customers,” said Arvind Tiwari, Chief Digital Services Officer, Jio Platforms Limited. “JioCDN represents our commitment to help ensure that every Indian business and consumer has access to one of the most secure, reliable, and innovative platforms in the country at pricing built for the Indian market.”


The JioCDN platform has already successfully handled some of the world’s most demanding live digital events, including Indian Premier League (IPL) matches and the ICC T20 World Cup 2026.


“When you’re streaming to tens of millions of concurrent viewers, you can’t afford to troubleshoot latency or chase down security gaps,” said Akash Saxena, Chief Technology Officer **,** JioHotstar. **** “JioCDN eliminates the complexity of delivering rich consumer experiences at scale so our teams don’t have to.”


**About Fastly**


Fastly’s powerful and programmable edge cloud platform helps the world’s top brands deliver online experiences that are fast, safe, and engaging through edge compute, delivery, security, and observability offerings that improve site performance, enhance security, and empower innovation at a global scale. Compared to other providers, Fastly’s powerful, high-performance, and modern platform architecture empowers developers to deliver secure websites and apps with rapid time-to-market and demonstrated, industry-leading cost savings. Organizations around the world trust Fastly to help them upgrade the internet experience, including Reddit, Universal Music Group, and SeatGeek.
